thread:
Noah (Partnerships): Heads up 
Vendor pushed a roadmap update: they renamed some SKU strings and added a B200-slim APAC-only SKU. Also flagged a Gaudi microcode derate for certain 64GB blades. Need alignment before marketplace freeze.
Ivy (Platform): Can you paste the renamed SKUs? we'll need to map manifest aliases and test images.
Noah (Partnerships): Vendor list in DM: `H200-48GB-v3`, `H100-80G`, `B200-slim-16`, `MI300-Pro-256`, `Gaudi-64k`. They want one manifest but will provide region availability tags.
Ruth (Marketing): Localization team has started translations for specific SKU strings. If names change we'll have to re-run TMs. Can we freeze text to family names (e.g., "B200 family") until canonical confirmed?
Chen (Billing): Billing needs canonical->aliases mapping by Monday EOD or revenue reconciliation breaks. If `-v3` vs `-48GB` mismatch we get charge disputes.
Vendor PM: Confirmed canonical strings are the list Noah posted. We'll publish signed containers and a patch note by tomorrow 06:00 UTC. APAC B200-slim will be region-tagged.
Ivy (Platform): Noted. Platform action: create alias mapping in manifest (canonical -> [aliases]); tag APAC nodes with `derated:microcode` until microcode applied.
Noah (Partnerships): Quick ask to Vendor: can the signed container include a release note with exact tag we can consume in CI? Also need hotfix checksum.
Vendor PM: Yes. Signed container will be `vendor/gaudi:2026-05-12-signed` and we'll include SHA256 in the release note.
Ivy (Platform): OK I'll queue CI rebuild once the signed image is published. Rough ETA: 30h for warm rebuild + smoke tests. If we hit regressions we'll need vendor to sign a follow-up fast.
Ruth (Marketing): I'll freeze copies to family names and prepare a neutral headline. If signed tags arrive by tomorrow, localization will swap placeholders and push Monday morning.
Chen (Billing): I'll draft the billing alias mapping PR mapping canonical -> aliases and include temporary fallback aliases to accept old strings. Will tag finance for signoff.
Noah (Partnerships): Let's meet 20m to confirm the flow at 3:00pm PT. Agenda: manifest aliasing, CI timing, marketing freeze, billing PR. I'll include vendor PM.
Ivy (Platform): Also flag: MI300-Pro-256 quantized kernels show ~2% perf delta on our internal perf harness. If vendor patch adjusts kernels, we should include a "performance note" in the announce pack.
Vendor PM: We'll provide kernel notes and a short statement you can use in the embargo pack.
Ruth (Marketing): Drafting an embargo blurb that uses family names and a footnote: "performance may vary; see marketplace notes". Staging link: https://redwood.example/embargo/roadmap_staging_v2.
Noah (Partnerships): Great. Action items summarized: Vendor - publish signed containers + release notes; Platform - alias manifest + CI rebuild; Billing - PR with alias mapping; Marketing - freeze and prepare neutral copy. Reconvene if any item slips.
